correctness.rationale: For equilibrium-initialized OU with independent Poisson resets to uniform past, all one-time marginals stay N(0,D/kappa), but the joint process is not stationary. Jump product calculus for A_t=int X and H=E[A_t X_t] gives J’=2H, H’=sigma²-(kappa+r)H+(r/t)J; thus J’’+(kappa+r)J’-(2r/t)J=2sigma² with J(0)=J’(0)=0. The moment bound J<=sigma² t² selects the regular solution. Laplace transform and Kummer inversion give the stated all-T expression and its beta=1 exponential-integral limit. The three asymptotics follow from beta=2r/(kappa+r) and Kummer negative-ray expansions; boundary r=kappa gives log(T)/T. Independently differentiated the analytic expression at three parameter times to verify the ODE residual to high precision. The claim excludes CLT, almost-sure limits, and nonharmonic potentials.
